name: Hollow Vulture Bone
summary: Across the Shimmering Flats, vultures circle the salt while goblin crews gather their bones. At the Mirage Raceway, mechanics use the hollow remains to lighten rocket cars without weakening them.

sections.title: Racing Materials on the Flats
sections.body: At the Mirage Raceway, goblin pit crews look for every way to make their rocket cars faster. Weight slows a car, so they use what the desert provides alongside iron and copper. Hollow vulture bones are light yet sturdy enough for steering rigs, internal brackets, and small supports. Pozzik and the other chief tinkerers gather them from local scavengers to save seconds on the track.

faq.q: Why do the goblins want vulture bones?
faq.answer: Pozzik and other goblin engineers use hollow vulture bones to lighten rocket cars. The bones are light and strong enough for steering rigs and small supports.

faq.q: Where do these bones come from?
aliases: where to find hollow vulture bone
faq.answer: Salt Flats Scavengers and Salt Flats Vultures provide the bones around the Shimmering Flats in Thousand Needles, especially near the giant skeletal remains scattered across the salt desert.
Pozzik is a goblin engineer and lead mechanic at the Mirage Raceway. He tunes and modifies rocket cars to compete against the gnomish team led by Fizzle Brassbolts.

angles.text: Goblin racers use hollow bird bones to save weight where iron and bronze would be heavy. Their choice shows a practical approach to racing design.
As a hunter, you can track the hardy carrion-feeding vultures across the blinding salt bed.
